info.name: Approval WeCom integration
info.summary: Send approval requests to WeCom (企业微信) and archive shared files after approval
info.description: Integrates the Approval app with WeCom (企业微信): approvers receive interactive template cards and can approve or reject directly inside WeCom. When a request is approved, the share mount point in each approver's files can be moved into a configurable date-organized archive folder. The original file of the requester is never touched.
info.author: Eli
